title: Race condition for "Disable Forced Wear on Missed Readings"
body:
If you are force collecting via Wear, and switch off your phone:

When you turn it on again, if the time delta is > than your `Disable Forced Wear on Missed Readings`, `Minutes since last Reading` value, the phone will disable forced Wear before Wear can sync and backfill BG data collected while the phone was off.

I experience this frequently as I turn off my phone most days at some point.

@old-square-eyes Is this still happening with the recent releases of xDrip?

@Navid200 No doesn't seem to happen any more. However, often the phone struggles to pick up the missed readings stored in the Wear DB for several cycles (or at all) without rebooting the phone and watch. During this time it can pass the threshold for "Disable Forced" and then the phone tries to take over. After that the readings on the watch seem orphaned. The phone then grabs the history from the TX (if you're using Native mode).

Sometimes it syncs after a reading or two though and it's fine.
